summary: CVE-2026-93524 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A buffer overread in CheckKeySyms() in X.Org X Server before 21.1.25 and XWayland before 24.1.14 could be used by authenticated X clients to leak small amounts of information from X server memory or potentially crash the X server.
